=== Corrections to SOAH Order No. 30 (1).docx ===





TO THE HONORABLE ADMINISTRATIVE LAW JUDGES: 

The following Pro Se Intervenors respectfully files this Motion to Correct Order No. 30 and Compel Accurate Identification of Affected Route Segments, and in support thereof would show: 

Background

On June 3, 2026, Applicants filed their Notice of Compliance with Prehearing Submission Requirements in SOAH Order Nos. 6 and 23, including Attachment 2, in PUC Interchange Item 5755 which Applicants state will serve as the basis for grouping intervenors by route segment and for the proposed order of presentation and cross-examination at the Hearing on the Merits. 
Attachment 2 contains an apparent error regarding the route segments affecting the following Pro Se Intervenors: Steve Schlumpberger, Brian J. Smith, Garry Harrell, Keith Foreman, Ruth Hsu, Kimberly Peelo. 
Applicants' filing incorrectly identifies Pro Se Intervenors (Steve Schlumpberger, Brian J. Smith, Garry Harrell, Keith Foreman, Ruth Hsu, Kimberly Peelo) under route segments J6, U6, K41, J22, G31, L3. 
However, Intervenor's testimony, exhibits, maps, correspondence with Applicants, Statements of Position, and prior filings consistently identify Pro Se Intervenors (Steve Schlumpberger, Brian J. Smith, Garry Harrell, Keith Foreman, Ruth Hsu, Kimberly Peelo) affected by G2, G13, and G6. 

    Il. NEED FOR CORRECTION 

SOAH Order No. 23 directed Applicants to group intervenors by route segment for purposes of hearing administration and presentation. 
Accurate identification of affected route segments is necessary to ensure an orderly hearing, proper witness grouping, meaningful cross-examination, and a complete record. 
The current designation inaccurately associates Intervenor with route segments that are not the subject of their testimony and fails to identify the route segments that are actually at issue with the Pro Se Intervenors (Steve Schlumpberger, Brian J. Smith, Garry Harrell, Keith Foreman, Ruth Hsu, Kimberly Peelo). 
Left uncorrected, the error may create confusion regarding the scope of Intervenor's testimony, prejudice the presentation of evidence, and impair efficient administration of the hearing. 

    Ill. REQUEST FOR RELIEF 

Pro Se Intervenors (Steve Schlumpberger, Brian J. Smith, Garry Harrell, Keith Foreman, Ruth Hsu, Kimberly Peelo) respectfully requests that the Administrative Law Judges direct Applicants to promptly review and correct Attachment 2 to accurately reflect that the Pro Se Intervenors (Steve Schlumpberger, Brian J. Smith, Garry Harrell, Keith Foreman, Ruth Hsu, Kimberly Peelo) are affected by route segments G2, G13, G6. 
Pro Se Intervenors further requests that any hearing presentation schedule, witness grouping, or cross-examination order derived from Attachment 2 be updated accordingly. 

Respectfully submitted, 
Steve Schlumpberger, Garry Harrell, Keith Foreman, Brian J. Smith, Ruth Hsu, Kimberly Peelo
Pro Se Intervenors
